title: Fault-detected ⇒ escalate: charge the three-way PIN budget on every sentinel/CFI/receipt trip, re-entrant fault ⇒ wipe, and zeroize SRAM before any glitch halt
threat: Every FI detection today ends in a refusal (return FAIL_SENTINEL / relock) or a bare `wfe` loop with master_secret still in SRAM and HandlerGuard suppressing the idle wipe. A stolen unlocked-capable device can therefore be glitch-characterised indefinitely: each failed attempt costs nothing, and a halt leaves the secrets resident for the next pulse.
proposal: (1) A single `fi::handle_fault(code)` sink (Trezor handle_fault + WF_ERROR_FATAL policy): static FihBool `in_progress` — a fault reported while one is being handled ⇒ immediate dual-SE admin wipe + page-125 flag; otherwise charge page 124 via pin_attempts_bump (which also advances E120/UserID on the next unlock by construction of the directional reconciliation), read back `pre+1`, zeroize_sensitive_state, then reset. Route check_true_into_sentinel failures at authorization sites, CfiCounter mismatches, ct_eq mismatches in c10_sign_verified, SCP03/CCM receipt failures, read_volatile_voted CounterUnstable, and `default:` arms of the fw_update/first-boot/sign-dispatch state machines through it. (2) halt_on_glitch and the panic path: zeroize SRAM secrets + TAMP BKERASE (BHK regs) + mask interrupts before `wfe`, on a fresh stack (Trezor call_with_new_stack); FSBL halt stays bare (no secrets). (3) Encode the state machines' phase words as sparse random u32s so a flipped enum lands in `default:`. Decide explicitly (owner) that genuine faults consume attempts — Trezor accepts this.
rationale: Bounds the attacker's glitch trials to the 10-attempt budget before self-destruction and makes the fault handler itself fault-hardened; cheap because every primitive (bump, admin wipe, zeroize, page-125 flag) already exists and only the policy wiring is missing. #835 H4 already adjudicated the halt-with-secrets problem; it is fixed only on a side branch.
repo_evidence: pqsigner-fi/src/lib.rs:274-285 (halt_on_glitch: bare wfe loop, no zeroize)
secure/src/fi.rs:106-117 (check_true/check_true_into_sentinel return a verdict; no escalation)
grep pin_attempts_bump secure/src → only nsc/mod.rs:1473 (gated_unlock) and cmd_test_pin_lockout.rs:158; no FI-trip site charges an attempt
gh #835 OPEN critical (H4: halt retains secrets; fix on perf/flash-opt-level-z only)
vendor_precedent: Trezor storage/storage.c:181-182,1815-1844 (handle_fault: in_progress ⇒ wipe; increment+verify PIN counter then halt); bootloader/main.c:677-690 (WF_ERROR_FATAL ⇒ secret_bhk_regenerate + erase_storage + backup_ram_erase); sys/startup/stm32/bootutils.c:103-199 (fresh stack, BKERASE, RAM fill before halt/reset).
risks: Interacts with #109/#692/#715 (page-124 charged on genuine SE InternalError; e2e images burn the budget on a persistent SE fault) — the policy must distinguish 'SE unreachable' from 'verdict inconsistent' or a flaky board bricks itself; owner decision #484 (halts must not touch peripherals) still holds, zeroize is register/SRAM only. Wipe-on-fault makes a bench FI campaign (FI-01) consume boards faster.
